title: Avatar of Fire
wikitext:
{{Passive skill box|Avatar of Fire}}

'''Avatar of Fire''' is a [[keystone passive skill]] that [[damage conversion|converts]] 50% of [[physical damage]], [[lightning damage]] and [[cold damage]] to [[fire damage]]. However, the character cannot deal damage with any damage types except fire. 

Like other offensive stats, Avatar of Fire's conversion and {{c|mod|Deal no Non-Fire Damage}} do not affect self-damage such as {{il|Blood Rage}} or {{il|Forbidden Rite}}.

In most situations, {{c|mod|Avatar of Fire}} will not synergize with {{psl|Elemental Equilibrium}}, since Elemental Equilibrium will add fire resistance to the enemy, while the player is unable to utilize the cold and lightning weakness.  One notable use case is when the player summons minions that primarily deal cold and lightning damage.  Since minions do not inherit Elemental Equilibrium, the player's fire damage will permanently weaken the enemy to cold and lightning.

==Location==
Avatar of Fire is located on the left side of the skill tree between the [[Templar]] and [[Marauder]] starting areas.
